## Mandatory text + image package (V0.9)

**Every X deliverable MUST contain final English copy AND an actual, checked, matched PNG/JPG image plus English ALT.** Source-only SVG, placeholder prompts, and text-only outputs cannot pass the release gate. If visual generation/export fails, the work stays `draft/image_missing`, not publication-ready. See [mandatory post-image gate](docs/POST-IMAGE-DELIVERY-GATE.md). Pre-existing #004 text-only draft is legacy and must be repaired before publication.

## V1.3 — AI efficiency & ethical monetization tutorial gate (2026-10-25)

**Only produce tutorial content when a specific AI/automation technology helps complete real work more efficiently OR offers a lawful, testable paid service.** General side-hustle articles, self-reported income, popular generic tools and outdated platform payout walkthroughs are inspiration only until they pass the value and compliance gate.

Never advise false KYC, bank/tax details or deceptive marketplace transactions.

Every X tutorial post must satisfy the existing **post+real PNG/JPG+ALT** gate.

## Today: 15–30 minute workflow

1. **Choose an entry point:** none → [dual-source daily prompt](prompts/DAILY-POST.md); high-signal X link → [X source prompt](prompts/X-HIGH-SIGNAL-TO-POST.md); project/Release/Skill link → [GitHub URL prompt](prompts/GITHUB-URL-TO-X.md); **full hands-on lesson → [Tutorial-to-X](prompts/TUTORIAL-TO-X.md)**. Ask ChatGPT to run it with web research and an actual English visual.
2. Verify original sources, generate **three distinct defensible angles**, challenge the strongest counterexample, and apply [Editorial Quality Gate V1](docs/EDITORIAL-QUALITY-GATE.md). Choose **one original, decision-changing idea**, not a project feature list.
3. Produce one English X post (default), max 3 Thread posts, check X-weighted length. For artwork, follow [the visual standard](docs/VISUAL-EDITORIAL-STANDARD.md): editorial clarity beats glossy generic AI gradients; every post must include a verified X-uploadable image.
4. Post on X manually, or use an available **X native scheduling UI** after checking your account supports it. Do not claim it was posted unless the X post URL exists.
5. Append one row in [post log](templates/posts.csv); record the post URL and numbers later. Spend time on **authentic human discussion**, not automated likes/replies.

**Publishing is not connected to this repository.** GitHub commits and ChatGPT drafts do not automatically publish to X; no API credentials or scheduler have been configured.

## Editorial promise

**"Expose a real technical bottleneck, explain the mechanism and give the reader a test worth running."**

- **Practical Skills / GitHub (30%)** — demonstrable, sourced, work-relevant individual skills; a reviewed 100-Skill candidate library is not a promise of 100 tested posts.
- **Verified AI / GitHub Improvements (30%)** — meaningful releases and real productivity mechanisms, never inflated 72-hour headlines.
- **Build-to-sell (20%)** — defined buyer, delivery, costs and real willingness-to-pay experiments; revenue not assumed.
- **Build & Learn reproducible tutorials (20%)** — step-by-step tested guides, visible checkpoints and a paired English X post+PNG/JPG.

News posts require a real event within the **execution-time rolling 72h**. Evergreen tutorials/Skills may be older, but **must never masquerade as a 72h release**. If nothing qualifies, publish a verified evergreen lesson instead.

## Guardrails

- No made-up releases, benchmark gains, revenue, customer stories, star deltas or pricing.
- No auto-follow, auto-like, unsolicited bulk replies/DMs or browser scripting to automate X.
- Respect third-party repo licenses and image permissions; do not paste third-party secrets into GitHub.
- Prefer one **reproducible proof** over ten sensational summaries.
- This private repo holds planning and links, **not X OAuth tokens** or unpublished business secrets.

## Long-term goal

**V0**: manually run the reusable prompt daily → **V1**: predictable content bank + experiments → **V2**: supported scheduling/publishing integrations if worth the cost → **V3**: analytics-assisted decisions → **V4**: selectively automated research, approvals and publishing. See [roadmap](docs/EVOLUTION-ROADMAP.md).
